subject.title: Control UI: Memory panel for MEMORY.md and USER.md

question: Should OpenClaw add a core Control UI memory editor for `USER.md`, `MEMORY.md`, and daily memory notes now, or wait for broader workspace-file and plugin contribution-slot designs?
rationale: The code can only partially satisfy this today, and the missing piece changes prompt-influencing persistent state from the browser while overlapping active workspace CRUD and plugin UI RFC work.

options.title: Define a narrow core memory panel
options.body: Approve a small core surface that edits only reviewed memory files and date-scoped daily notes with explicit authorization and safety rules.

options.title: Defer to plugin contribution slots
options.body: Keep this open behind #71736 so memory/context plugins can contribute a host-rendered panel without adding another core UI contract now.

options.title: Fold into workspace CRUD
options.body: Treat the memory panel as a specialized view on top of the broader workspace file-management effort once #61368/#62417 is resolved safely.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow core memory panel
recommendation.body: Approve a small core surface that edits only reviewed memory files and date-scoped daily notes with explicit authorization and safety rules.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is product/security boundary direction across workspace files, memory, and Control UI surfaces, and this handle owns the nearest current read-only workspace boundary.
